Allowance.description: Port of adcp#8102 seller-adjustable-term.json. A change that satisfies constraint and min_notice creates a media buy revision with no offer; anything else needs a seller offer. Never changes a unit price and never raises what the buyer pays.

path.description: RFC 6901 pointer into the purchase. No array indexes.

Allowance.title: Seller Adjustment Allowance

value.description: A complete replacement value, with the same schema as the field at path.

AppliedAdjustment.description: Port of adcp#8102 applied-seller-adjustment.json. One application advances the media buy revision; the matching account change record (account.change_recorded) carries change_id.

change_id.description: The account change feed record for this revision.

revision.description: The media buy revision this application created.

AppliedAdjustment.title: Applied Adjustment

AppliedAdjustments.description: Readback of changes the seller applied under this buy's accepted allowances, oldest first.
AppliedAdjustments.title: Applied Adjustments

Constraint.description: Tagged on kind. A later kind is another variant under another digest; a buyer pinned to an earlier digest never sees a variant it cannot read.
Constraint.title: Allowance Constraint

min.description: The value after the change MUST NOT be lower.

allowances.description: Unique by allowance_id, ordered by allowance_id (stable terms_digest).

x-adcp-extension.description: Fields of a purchase the buyer pre-authorizes the seller to change without an offer, and the bounds. Ports adcp#8102 core/seller-adjustable-term.json and makes the constraint a tagged union on `kind` (PR #8102 review), so a later kind is another variant, and an unknown kind fails closed instead of being misread.

extends.semantics: Readback in get_media_buys: the changes the seller applied under the accepted allowances. The seller writes it with the same uri@digest as the accepted commercial_terms entry, and announces each change through the core change feed (account.change_recorded, origin seller_system); the extension has no notification type of its own.

x-adcp-extension.name: seller-adjustable-terms

promotion.rule: 2+ independent adopters with substantively similar allowances for 90+ days

x-adcp-extension.title: Seller adjustable terms (pre-authorized unilateral changes)
